Magnetic north/south are not related to axial tilt. While the latter changes slightly (+/- 2 degrees over a 41k year cycle), the former can move due to any of a number of deep-earth phenomena that aren't necessarily related to a warming trend. Some gradual warming is expected (as well as modest change in glacial coverage) due to changes in axial tilt, but certainly not in the magnitude nor time scale we're seeing today.

It's part of the trend, but it doesn't tell the whole story.
